location_s: Head office Hangzhou, Zhejiang; PCB and SMT factories at Longwangmiao Industrial Park, Fuyong, Bao'an District, Shenzhen; further industrial bases listed in Guangde (Anhui) and Jiangxi
process_s: online standard PCB order (capabilities page 'PCB Capabilities' table: 1-14 layers, FR-4); floors below are that table unless noted; 'Normal process' column of the Advanced PCB table used where the standard table is silent

turn_times_fab-ao.condition: 0-50 pcs & < 1 m2 ('Original Lead Time 2-3 Days', 'Current Lead Time 24 Hours'); counted after Gerber review/approval
< 1 m2; extra urgent 48 hours; 1-5 m2 7 days; > 5 m2 8 days

shipping_us-ao.from: China (Hangzhou / Shenzhen not stated per order)

cutoff_note: Pay on or before 8:30 GMT for fabrication to start the same day; DHL pickups 12:00 and 18:00-18:30 UTC+8 (American line 8-9 pm), FedEx 16:30 UTC+8 (https://www.pcbway.com/shipping_method_guide.aspx).
times_not_published_as: layer counts covered by the standard-PCB 24 h lead-time table
business vs calendar days for standard PCB lead times
min_via_diameter_note-s: derived, not printed: min drill 0.15 mm + 2 x min annular ring 0.15 mm ('For pads with vias in the middle, Min width for Annular Ring is 0.15mm(6mil)'). Drills < 0.2 mm carry an extra charge, so the no-surcharge via is 0.2 mm drill / 0.5 mm pad.
min_hole_to_hole_note-s: Advanced PCB table row 10 'Hole to hole spacing', normal process: via (<=0.45 mm) >= 11 mil; component hole >= 16 mil
silkscreen_source-s: PCBWay capabilities, Legend: Min Character Width 0.15mm ("Characters of less than 0.15mm wide will be too narrow to be identifiable"), Min Character Height 0.8mm ("Characters of less than 0.8mm high will be too small to be recognizable"), width-to-height ratio 1:5. https://www.pcbway.com/capabilities.html, read 2026-10-21
min_solder_mask_dam_note-s: Advanced PCB table row 23 'green solder mask Bridge (mil)', normal process: '4 (spacing between ICs is 8 mil, green oil), variegated or black oil >=4.5mil'. The standard-PCB solder-mask page instead states pad spacing: 'the spacing between IC pads should be min 0.19mm(7.5mil) for green, blue, red, purple ... others require min 0.22mm(9mil)' at 1 oz (https://www.pcbway.com/pcb_prototype/PCB_Solder_mask.html).
min_solder_mask_clearance_note-s: Advanced PCB table row 23 'green solder mask opening (mil) >=2mil' normal process; solder-mask page: 'the suggested soldermask clearance in GERBER is 2-4 mils'
min_board_edge_clearance_note-s: Advanced PCB table row 19 'Line to board edge distance, CNC milling' normal process 0.25 mm (medium difficulty 0.20 mm)
max_layers_note-s: standard table '1-14 layers'; above 14 via Advanced PCB (stackup page lists up to 18 layers; Advanced table 3-16 L normal, 18-24 L medium)
materials_note-s: standard table; Advanced PCB adds Rogers 4 series + FR-4 mixed (ShengYi prepreg), LianMao IT158/IT180A, CEM-3, PTFE, flex, rigid-flex, HDI, high-Tg, halogen-free
impedance_note-s: via 'Customized Services and Advanced Options' (custom stackup or impedance control) per the stackup page; impedance tolerance not stated on the pages read
max_aspect_ratio_note-s: Advanced PCB table row 6 'Thickness to diameter ratio <=8' normal process (8-10 medium, >12 high)
via_in_pad_note: Via-in-pad = resin-filled with electroplated cap on BGA pads unless the customer asks otherwise (https://www.pcbway.com/pcb_prototype/PCB_Via_in_Pad.html); plug hole 0.20-0.40 mm (70% fullness) for 0.40-2.4 mm boards (Advanced table row 23). No minimum VIP drill or turn-time effect published.
note: PCBWay standard online PCB: 4/4 mil (0.1 mm) trace/space, 0.15 mm minimum drill (holes < 0.2 mm cost extra), 0.15 mm via annular ring, 1-14 layers. The Advanced PCB table on the capabilities page gives per-copper-weight trace/space before compensation (outer 35 um: 5/6 mil normal, 5/5 mil medium; inner 35 um: 4/5 mil normal) which are stricter than the standard 4/4 mil headline; this profile uses the standard-table headline values. Pages read with curl + browser user agent on 2026-10-17.
barrel_plating_source-s: PCBWay Advanced PCB Capabilities table row 21 'Hole copper thickness (µm) | Through hole | 18-25 µm' (normal process; 30-50 µm medium difficulty, >50 µm high); value is the lower end of the 18-25 µm range; no IPC class or average/minimum wording. https://www.pcbway.com/capabilities.html, read 2026-10-17
copper_foil_note-s: not published (foil type, roughness). Stackups print outer 'Outer Base Copper 0.5OZ' 0.0175 mm '(Plating to 1OZ)' and 1.5 oz base (0.0525 / 0.0520 mm) plated to 2 oz; capabilities page: '35μm=1oz, 70μm=2oz'. https://www.pcbway.com/multi-layer-laminated-structure.html, https://www.pcbway.com/capabilities.html, read 2026-10-17
laminate_df_note-s: no Df and no laminate brand for the standard stackups; Dk printed per sheet: 7628 RC46% DK 4.74, 2116 RC58% DK 4.45, 3313 RC58% DK 4.45, 1080 RC68% DK 4.21, Core DK 4.6 (frequency not stated). Advanced table names ShengYi prepreg for Rogers/FR-4 mixed builds. https://www.pcbway.com/multi-layer-laminated-structure.html, read 2026-10-17
via_in_pad_standard_source-s: Online order form, Additional Options: "All vias filled with resin and capped", "Via in pad" (orderonline.aspx); via-in-pad page: "The via on the BGA is generally defined as via-in-pad, and requires resin filling, with an electroplated cap." https://www.pcbway.com/orderonline.aspx , https://www.pcbway.com/pcb_prototype/PCB_Via_in_Pad.html, read 2026-10-17; charged, no custom quote; no layer condition stated

stackups_note: All 298 'PCB standard stackup' entries from the page HTML (4-18 layers; 112 x 4L, 74 x 6L, 49 x 8L, 33 x 10L, 12 x 12L, 6 each 14/16/18L; no 2-layer stackups published). Through-hole stackups only ('not applicable for blind and buried vias'). Each table prints Thickness (mm) and Thickness after lamination (mm): prepreg thickness_mm is the after-lamination value; core and inner copper use the printed thickness (their after-lamination cell is the 'Core with Cu' total); outer copper is the printed base foil (0.0175 mm for 0.5 oz) with the table's '(Plating to 1OZ)' kept in printed-s, so finished outer copper is thicker than thickness_mm. measured_total_mm matches each table's 'Thickness after lamination' to within 0.01 mm; the finished board thickness (printed separately, e.g. 1.61 mm) adds plating, mask and finish. Where several prepreg sheets share one after-lamination value: same type -> one prepreg layer with that thickness; mixed types with different DK (85 stackups) -> one layer per sheet with the shared thickness split in proportion to the printed raw sheet thickness (flagged thickness_derived-s). Ordering: first 1.6 mm entry of 4/6/8/10/12 layers (1 oz outer / 1 oz inner / 70% residual copper, 'Regular'), then the rest in page order. Many entries differ only in inner residual copper ratio (90/70/50/30%), which changes the after-lamination prepreg thickness. Left out: 105 published stackups in which several prepreg sheets share one printed after-lamination thickness (a per-sheet thickness would have to be derived). Outer copper is printed as the base foil (0.0175 mm, 'Plating to 1OZ'), so outer thickness_mm is thinner than finished copper. Order: one stackup per layer count first (1.6 mm where published), since the reader takes the first 8.
